class.name: CylinderVoxelGenerator4D
class.brief_description: A generator filling a vertical cylinder and the rest of space with different materials.
class.description: CylinderVoxelGenerator4D generates one material filling a vertically aligned cylinder and another filling the rest of space. With the default materials, it can be used with a [LayeredVoxelGenerator4D] to cut off generation outside the cylinder.

members.member: The center of the cylinder, in voxel coordinates.
The cylinder's full extent along the vertical (Y) axis, in voxels.
The material filling the cylinder, or [code]255[/code] to leave it undefined.
The material filling the space outside the cylinder, [code]254[/code] for air by default, or [code]255[/code] to leave it undefined.
The radius of the cylinder over the three horizontal axes, in voxels.
